additional_info.subject: RE: ID0373767-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P6 170000686] OCPP Offline CRM:01811000216
additional_info.body:
Hello  team,
The charger is offline on SCB we cannot troubleshoot remotely, please arrange a site intervention and perform following steps:
Please verify the successful integration of the OCPP backend with our Sicharge D?
To determine which network our SIM is currently using, please access the Teltonika router's web portal using the correct IP address after establishing a successful connection with your laptop. Ensure that the network connection is 4G, not 2G.
Verify if the 'WebSocketPingInterval' is set to 30 seconds in the backend? This setting ensures the best OCPP connection
Ensure the customer has a stable data connection with sufficient data volume
Please reconfigure router2 with the correct APN credentials
Please check if the SIM card is inserted incorrectly by cleaning and then reinserting it into the XF4 router.
Please perform a hard reset and then reinsert the SIM card.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0373767 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :

additional_info.body:
Hello,
I went on site today and I connected my computer to the charger. I saw on the Teltonika Router Siemens (10.20.17.1) that the SIM Card was not inserted and not connected. I just did a “register” on the teltonika router mobile connection and the SCB communication went back online.
So, I will change the Siemens router next time with the one that the French Team sent me this week. I will tell you when I change the router and if it’s working, you will close the ticket,
Thank you,
